Kerala Minister to address CorroHealth worker concerns amid layoffs

Kerala's Labour Minister is scheduled to hold discussions on July 10 regarding the layoffs at CorroHealth, a company that has left its employees uncertain about their future. The government has stated it is taking measures to protect the affected workers. An IT forum in Kerala has also called for the redeployment of these employees before new hiring commences.
